description: Dependency update pull requests for seafile-helm, on the shared preset of ioanalytica/renovate-config (schedule, minimum release age, DCO, review requests, the label decision): the images values.yaml pins, GitHub Actions and the Helm the workflow chart.yaml installs.

customManagers.description: Tool versions of the workflows, an env *_VERSION under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' line.

packageRules.description: The notification server and the metadata server follow the Seafile series of appVersion (13): their 14 belongs to Seafile 14. Raise this with appVersion; check-upstream.yaml reports a new stable series.
SeaDoc 2 is the one the compose files of Seafile 13.0 run (sdoc-server:2.0-latest); 3.x is a parallel line with no documented Seafile 13 support.
Seafile Pro 10.0 and later supports Elasticsearch 8.x only (https://manual.seafile.com/14.0/setup/use_elasticsearch/), as max-major=8 in check-internal-images.yaml says.
